findings.claim: The unrelated MessagePackSecurity copy change silently drops HashCollisionResistant when security options are copied. A copy of options configured for collision-resistant hashing can therefore revert to the destination's existing/default value, weakening protection for untrusted data; this is contrary to the product's recorded collision-resistance behavior and is outside REQ-2297.

receipt_plan.detail: Add or run a MessagePackSecurity copy-constructor/CopyFrom test: configure the source with HashCollisionResistant = true, copy it into another instance, and assert the destination remains true. Also verify the remaining security properties are preserved. The changed line makes this assertion fail.
